why: A header bar pasted from one pane into the next, then a third time into a styles file with its classes reordered; its label's classes a third time inside cn() and through triggerClassName. A design-system panel bar with two of its three copies in packages/ui/src, so the line goes missing if the guard stops reading the package (MAR-3610). The copies in a test and in a story must not count: each expected line names exactly three copies. Runs with the repo's own scripts/guards/repeated-classes.json.
